answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 40974 Country: India Title: I am a 23 year old boy and affected by jadu and jinn mentally and physically am growing weak day by day Question: I am a 23 year old boy and affected by jadu and jinn mentally and physically am growing weak day by day. I left study after 9th class then I went for 4 month tablighi Jamah. But I am not able to set my business or job. I am facing failure everywhere. Please do dua for me and tell me some dua to recite for it. I am having headache all the time. I am in depression as well. Answer ID: 40974 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1430/910/L=1433) Recite la haul (لا حول ولا قوۃ الا باللہ العلی العظیم) five hundred times with durood 100-100 times before and after in the state of wudhu any time during day. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
